reason: Seeing the drawer cash and who is in the chair when I'm at my other work is exactly what I want, but for one or two chairs, ₹4,999 up front plus ₹999 every month is a lot from what I earn. Most customers pay UPI anyway, so I already see most of the money on my phone.
objection: Who will help me when the app stops working on a busy Sunday and I'm not there? My barber will just go back to the notebook and I'll still be paying ₹999.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee, or the setup fee back if it doesn't work, plus a Hindi or local-language phone number that actually answers on Sundays.
